ValidationRule.description: Uses Method of Contact picklist value to check either Mobile Number or Email field values for blank values.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR((ISPICKVAL( Method_of_Contact__c ,'Phone') && ISBLANK(Mobile_Number__c)), ISPICKVAL( Method_of_Contact__c ,'Email') && ISBLANK(Email__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a value for the phone or email related to Method of Contact value.
